name: animated-circular-progress-bar
title: Animated Circular Progress Bar
description: Animated Circular Progress Bar is a component that displays a circular gauge with a percentage value.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the gauge. Size it with `size-*` and the number with `text-*`.

props.name: max
props.description: Value at which the gauge is full.

props.name: min
props.description: Value at which the gauge is empty.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value. The centre shows it as a percentage of `min`–`max`.

props.name: gaugePrimaryColor
props.description: Colour of the filled arc (any CSS colour, including `var(--x)`).
